meta.title: Xiaojingniang Desktop Pet 2.0
meta.description: The original character Xiaojingniang lives on your screen: a daily smile, a smug squint while you are waiting for an answer, a celebration when a task finishes, teary eyes when you deny an approval, a broke-and-crying face when one task runs too long, and sleepiness between midnight and 6am. Drag her anywhere; right-click to change colours, change outfit, hide, or quit — your choice is remembered.
